name: 80920 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80920 (Colorado Spgs) has 191 nonprofit organizations. 94 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 78 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80920 (Colorado Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80920 (Colorado Spgs) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 78 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
